title: State floor values as Int equations for floors under applications
summary: The Lean reconstructor now states the value of a floor (to_int) as an equation between Int terms, so floors that are arguments of uninterpreted functions, predicates, and array reads verify in Lean after Z3's rewriter simplifies them. On a random family of such inputs, 109 of 148 refutations failed in Lean on the clause log before and all 148 verify now, with no new axiom.
